cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Agree to the Exact Words
cards.instruction: Agree to the exact wording, then use later callbacks to narrow what those words can obligate you to do.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One box to the van, agreed. I've ticked this one like you did.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: My ticks mark empty boxes. The full ones are over by the door.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, checking the supply. Choose my one full box, then.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Take the big one. It'll need two trips; half the books won't fit until you unload the first half.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Two trips is two loads. You can choose a full box, or fill this empty one once. I agreed to carry one.
